## Problem or Opportunity / Problema u Oportunidad
Is your feature request related to a problem or a new game customization opportunity?
*¿Tu solicitud está relacionada con una limitación actual o una oportunidad de personalización?*

## Proposed Solution / Solución Propuesta

## Alternatives Considered / Alternativas Consideradas
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context / Contexto Adicional
Add any other context, technical offsets, or screenshots about the feature request here.
